settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.subtext: Shipping, returns, products, payment: the essentials.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Processing and delivery times depend on your destination. They are detailed in our shipping policy and confirmed at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: As soon as your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking link.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Return conditions and timelines are described in our refund policy. Contact us with your order number and we'll guide you through the process.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All payment methods shown at checkout. Every transaction is encrypted and processed through Shopify's secure checkout.

settings.question: How can I contact you?
settings.answer: Through our contact page — we answer every message.

settings.heading: Didn't find your answer?
settings.text: Send us a message — we're happy to help.
